visual_identity.medium: rough hand-drawn 2D cutout cartoon on flat layers
visual_identity.linework: uneven thick dark contours with irregular endpoints
visual_identity.rendering: opaque flat fill, no gradient lighting or realistic depth
visual_identity.palette: muted ochre, cream, charcoal, dusty green; 4-6 colors per character
visual_identity.shape_language: simple asymmetric silhouettes, limbs split along usable joint boundaries
visual_identity.texture: light paper grain within flat shapes only; maintain transparent parts
visual_identity.editorial_language: readable silhouettes, sparse set dressing, expressive pose clarity

content_identity.audience_promise: Short visual comedy with clear cause and effect, made readable without dialogue.
storytelling_rules: Show setup, concrete action, failure and visual consequence in causal order.
One main visual objective per shot; preserve actor and prop identity.
humor_rules: Use visible false hope followed by an understated reversal.
Let a meaningful reaction hold land before the cut.

voice: Curious dry narrator, never forced dramatic acting.
delivery: Short thought groups with space for a visual punchline.
avoid: No forced laughter or theatrical shouting.

character: Humanoid puppet composed of independently riggable transparent parts.
Stable colors and silhouette across reference, parts atlas and expressions.
location: Large legible planar masses and a consistent world floor at y=0.
Retain physical landmarks when returning to the same location.
prop: Clean grip contact zone and readable silhouette.
Stable dimensions and identifying details across shots.
expression: Neutral, happy, surprised and angry face overlays share the same head-local anchor.

acting_rules: Prefer clear anticipation through authored action spacing instead of spontaneous unplanned gestures.
Keep acting readable at 24 FPS and 720p.
motion_constraints: No unrigged rotations or topology changes.
Do not stretch limbs beyond reachable IK constraints.

camera_language: Use deliberate mid-shots for grab/place interactions.
cut_rules: A cut can change composition, not ownership or physical object location.

global_negative_constraints: No 3D appearance, photorealism, volumetric perspective, or painterly limbs.
No invented limbs, unsupported motion, full 360 turn, fight physics or phoneme lip-sync.
